newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia reports biggest drug seizure.
newsitem.headline: Australia reports biggest drug seizure.

text.p: Australian customs officials on Thursday announced the nation's largest drug cargo seizure of more than five tonnnes of compressed cannibis, worth A$50 million (US$39 million), found in a ship in Sydney last month.
They said drugs were seized on November 13 but the announcement was delayed pending further investigations, but no arrests have been made.
The Australian-owned ship, Anro Australia, arrived in Sydney's Port Botany on November 9 from Cambodia.
The cannibis was found compressed in 258 rice bags behind a false wall in a container of jute.

"A customs detector dog team examined the container when it arrived in Sydney from Cambodia and the dog gave strong indications that drugs were present," Customs Minister Geoff Prosser said in a statement.
Prosser said the seizure was "the largest quantity of illegal drugs ever found in cargo in Australia".
